C1.worst_defect: Hero says 'Point of sale for Vendure' and 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0' but never says who it is for or not for, and there is no comparison with Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed or the WooCommerce/Odoo tills; a client cannot tell in five seconds why this over a hosted POS
C1.where: home.desktop.01 hero; no comparison or 'not for you if' section anywhere on home

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' open-source till, yet building it yourself needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)', a commercial licence never called paid or priced; the free path is app.vendurepos.com with no stated operator, terms or longevity, and demo usage events go to an unexplained third domain 'ph.wcpos.com'
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' and 'Live demo or your own store' table; limitations 'Setting up the store'; connect-a-till 'Where requests go'

C3.worst_defect: The plugin's own till role ships broken and the docs ask the user to patch it: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself'; known since 0.2.0 and still unfixed
C3.where: quick-start.phone.04/05 step 4 and 'device key' section; changelog 'Not in the release notes'

C4.worst_defect: Changelog is written for maintainers: 'GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)', 'order.create v5 custom lines … TALLY-CUSTOM-ITEM'; and Notifications is a whole page for 'Today the till has one notice'

C5.worst_defect: 404 page is three buttons over a mostly empty screen with no search field, and code blocks and callouts look stock-template rather than designed

C6.worst_defect: '2. Add TallyPosPlugin to your existing Vendure config' heading wraps to three lines around an inline code chip, and the tall till screenshot pushes the CTAs and first proof below the fold on phone

C7.worst_defect: OG card crops the till's 'Add charge' button at the bottom edge and says nothing about open source or pre-release; JSON-LD SoftwareApplication has no softwareVersion or offers; search results carry only the breadcrumb 'VendurePOS'
C7.where: og-image.png; tech.json jsonld and search sample

overall_worst.defect: The site leads with an 'open-source till' and 'MIT licensed', yet self-hosting needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)', a commercial licence the site never calls paid or prices; in practice a client depends on app.vendurepos.com, and no page says who operates it, on what terms, or what happens if it goes away. A sceptic advising a client reads this as lock-in dressed as open source.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start'; limitations 'Setting up the store'; connect-a-till 'Where requests go'
overall_worst.fix: Add one plain line on home and in Limitations: 'Building the till yourself needs an RxDB Premium licence, a paid third-party licence (link, price). Or use the hosted till at app.vendurepos.com, run by <operator>, free during pre-release; if it shuts, <what happens to your data and how to self-host>.'
